items.title: 67247_J.C. Higginbotham oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee (Charlie Parker) does not speak in the provided context. The interviewer mentions 'Open the Door, Richard' and later 'Richard's son', but there is no evidence of a personal relationship between the interviewee and Richard.

ctx.x: You remember the guy that said, 'Charlie, open the door?' He played at the Strand Theatre.

He didn't get famous until he was almost ready to die. He played at the Strand Theatre, that I know. When Jay and them was playing at the theatre or even in the pit, Josephine Baker would come over to New York. She was the entertainer and there would be quite a few entertainers, white and colored.
